stories.headline: US-Iran sign interim MoU ending war; oil falls to pre-war lows as Strait of Hormuz reopens

key_facts.fact: Trump and his Iranian counterpart signed a 14-point memorandum of understanding remotely on Wednesday evening June 17, ahead of an originally planned Friday signing in Switzerland; the deal entered into force with immediate effect.
key_facts.excerpt: According to Axios, the MOU was signed remotely by Trump, Vance and Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, moving forward a deal that had originally been expected to be signed in Switzerland on Friday.

key_facts.fact: The agreement covers an immediate end to hostilities (including in Lebanon), reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, lifting of the US naval blockade, and opens a 60-day negotiation period on Iran's nuclear program.
key_facts.excerpt: Sharif said Iran would 'instantly reopen' the Strait of Hormuz and the US would 'immediately' lift its naval blockade of Iranian ports

key_facts.fact: Brent crude futures fell 2.33% to $77.69/barrel on Thursday, while WTI fell 2.46% to $74.90 — Brent's lowest since February 27, the last trading day before the US-Israeli strikes on Iran began.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures were down $1.85, or 2.33%, at $77.69 a barrel at 11:15 a.m. CDT (1615 GMT), while U.S. West Texas Intermediate fell $1.89, or 2.46%, to $74.90 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: Under the MoU the US will allow Iran to sell oil and petrochemical products, and the deal requires the US and partners to come up with a $300 billion plan to finance Iran's recovery if Tehran meets nuclear commitments.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the draft agreement, the US will allow Iran to sell its oil and petrochemical products, and Tehran may be able to tap into a US$300bn development fund if it meets commitments related to its nuclear programme in further negotiations.

key_facts.fact: VP JD Vance said tankers carrying more than 12 million barrels crossed the Strait of Hormuz overnight Thursday; the deal calls for full traffic capacity to be restored within 30 days.
key_facts.excerpt: Vice President JD Vance said tankers with more than 12 million barrels crossed the strait overnight. 'The Iranians, for the second night in a row, did not shoot at any ships in the Strait of Hormuz,' Vance told reporters.

key_facts.fact: The MoU defers Iran's nuclear program and missile issues to a 60-day negotiation period; Trump warned the US could 'go right back to dropping bombs' if Iran doesn't comply.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump warned on Wednesday that the U.S. could resume its attacks on Iran if it did not comply with the deal.

stories.headline: SpaceX prepares $20B investment-grade bond sale to refinance xAI-acquisition bridge loan

key_facts.fact: SpaceX bankers are preparing to hold investor calls as early as Monday next week to discuss a bond sale of at least $20 billion — the company's first investment-grade dollar bond issue.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX's bankers are preparing to meet investors as early as next week to discuss a bond offering of at least $20 billion, two sources familiar with the matter said on Thursday

key_facts.fact: Proceeds will refinance a $20 billion bridge loan taken in February after SpaceX acquired Musk's xAI; the bridge facility matures in September 2027 and accounted for most of SpaceX's $29.1 billion in long-term debt as of March 31.
key_facts.excerpt: The bond proceeds would refinance a temporary $20 billion bridge loan that matures in September 2027. The bridge loan makes up the bulk of SpaceX's $29.1 billion of long-term debt as of March 31

key_facts.fact: Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley provided the original bridge and are expected to run the bond deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley provided the bridge financing and are expected to run the deal

key_facts.fact: Moody's assigned SpaceX a Baa1 rating on June 18, Fitch gave it BBB+ and S&P assigned BBB — all investment grade.
key_facts.excerpt: Moody's assigned SpaceX a Baa1 rating on June 18, Fitch gave it BBB+ and S&P Global Ratings assigned BBB. All three are investment grade, above speculative grade.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX's valuation surged past $2 trillion following last week's Nasdaq debut; the company has a roughly $45 billion compute deal with Anthropic over about the next three years and $4.2B contracted with Alphabet.
key_facts.excerpt: The rockets-to-AI company's valuation surged past $2 trillion following its blockbuster Nasdaq debut last week.

stories.headline: US Commerce Sec Lutnick tells ASML he suspects a top EUV chip tool may have reached China

key_facts.fact: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told ASML senior leaders in a series of recent meetings that he's concerned one of the Dutch company's EUV lithography machines may have made it into China in violation of US-led export restrictions.
key_facts.excerpt: In a series of recent meetings, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick outlined concerns to ASML's senior leaders that one of its top-of-the-line machines may have made its way into China, in violation of US-led export restrictions.

key_facts.fact: ASML has never been allowed to ship EUV systems to China due to curbs imposed under the first Trump administration; EUV machines are required by TSMC to manufacture processors for Nvidia and Apple.
key_facts.excerpt: EUV systems are used by firms such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. to manufacture processors for the likes of Nvidia and Apple, and ASML has never been allowed to ship them to China

key_facts.fact: ASML created and circulated a document in Washington titled 'No indication of any ASML EUV System in China' after the April meeting with Lutnick; it states there are 314 EUV machines in operation worldwide, 26 decommissioned, and none in China.
key_facts.excerpt: There are 314 EUV machines in operation around the world, 26 that have been decommissioned, and none in China, according to the document

key_facts.fact: Senior administration officials told Bloomberg they have evidence ASML shipped specialty equipment used to transport EUV machines as well as other components, but said the proof is too sensitive to disclose.
key_facts.excerpt: The senior administration officials said that they have evidence of ASML shipping to China specialty equipment used to transport EUV machines, as well as other components that could be used in EUV systems. The proof of those exports is too sensitive to disclose

key_facts.fact: A bipartisan bill moving through Congress would go further and ban all of ASML's deep ultraviolet (DUV) shipments to China; DUV accounts for roughly 20% of ASML's expected 2026 revenue. The bill cleared a key committee in April.
key_facts.excerpt: a bipartisan bill moving through Congress would go much further than EUV — it calls for an effective ban on all of ASML's deep ultraviolet (DUV) shipments to China, the less advanced lithography tools that account for roughly a fifth of the company's expected 2026 revenue.

key_facts.fact: ASML says EUV machines are the size of a school bus, weigh 180 tons, and that customers 'cannot remove, transport and relocate EUV systems without ASML involvement due to specialised handling procedures.'
key_facts.excerpt: ASML's most advanced EUV systems are roughly the size of a school bus and weigh 180 tons. 'ASML has never shipped an EUV machine to China nor have we shipped to China any component, module or equipment specially designed to be used in an EUV machine'

stories.headline: Reliance's Jio Platforms files DRHP for India IPO valued by analysts at $130–180B

key_facts.fact: Reliance Industries chairman Mukesh Ambani announced at the company's 49th AGM on June 19 that Jio Platforms' board approved the draft red herring prospectus, which will be filed with SEBI the same day.
key_facts.excerpt: 'The board of Jio Platforms has approved the draft red herring prospectus earlier today and it will be filed with SEBI today,' said RIL chairperson Ambani in his AGM address.

key_facts.fact: The IPO will be a fresh issue of up to 27 crore (270 million) equity shares of face value Rs 10 each; the issue price will be set through a book-building process.
key_facts.excerpt: Jio Platforms' mega IPO will consist of fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares of face value of Rs 10 each, Reliance Industries said in a BSE filing on Friday.

key_facts.fact: Analysts estimate the Jio IPO could be India's biggest public offering ever, with a valuation of $130–180 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Analysts estimate that the Jio IPO can be the biggest public offer till date at a valuation of $130-180 billion, as per reports.

key_facts.fact: RIL currently holds 66.43% of Jio Platforms, with Meta and Google holding significant portions of the remainder.
key_facts.excerpt: RIL currently holds 66.43% of Jio Platforms, with Meta and Google holding a significant portion of the remaining shares.

key_facts.fact: Ambani said the IPO process is being led by his children Akash, Isha and Anant, and called the Jio listing the company's most significant value-creation event of the year.
key_facts.excerpt: He said the IPO process is being led by his children Akash, Isha and Anant, who will spearhead the next phase of growth and value creation at Jio.

stories.headline: Accenture spends $4.18B on Dragos majority stake plus runZero and NetRise to push into OT security

key_facts.fact: Accenture announced Thursday it will take a majority stake in Dragos and fully acquire runZero and NetRise at a combined enterprise value of approximately $4.175 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Accenture has entered into agreements to acquire a majority stake in Dragos and 100% of runZero and NetRise at a combined enterprise value of approximately $4.175 billion

key_facts.fact: The Dragos majority stake is valued at $3.25 billion; the deal builds on Accenture's existing $10 billion cybersecurity business and the targets together generate $208 million in annual recurring revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: Accenture announced Thursday it would acquire a majority stake in industrial cybersecurity firm Dragos for $3.25 billion and purchase two smaller security companies outright, essentially making a $4.18 billion bet

key_facts.fact: Dragos is an OT threat-detection specialist; runZero (founded by Metasploit creator HD Moore) handles asset discovery and attack-surface intelligence; NetRise focuses on firmware-level visibility and software supply chain security.
key_facts.excerpt: NetRise contributes deep firmware analysis and software supply chain visibility capabilities, while runZero, the company founded by renowned cybersecurity expert and Metasploit creator HD Moore, adds advanced asset discovery, exposure assessment, and attack surface intelligence.

key_facts.fact: The transactions are expected to close in August or September 2026; Dragos CEO Robert M. Lee will continue leading the combined business.
key_facts.excerpt: The transactions are expected to close in August or September 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals.

key_facts.fact: Accenture shares fell over 11% in premarket trading as the company cut its FY revenue growth forecast top end to 3–4% (from 3–5%), signaling weak discretionary IT consulting spend.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Accenture fell over 11 per cent in premarket trading as the company cut the top end of its annual revenue growth forecast range, signalling businesses wary of an uncertain economy are curtailing spending on discretionary IT consulting projects.

stories.headline: India's Telegram ban triggers 49% VPN download spike; Delhi High Court upholds restriction

key_facts.fact: Tuesday June 16 marked the biggest VPN-app download day in India since at least the start of 2025; downloads of major VPN apps rose 49% from a daily average of 139,000 to 208,000, per Appfigures.
key_facts.excerpt: App intelligence firm Appfigures told TechCrunch that Tuesday, the day India announced the Telegram restriction, marked the biggest day for VPN app downloads in the country since at least the start of 2025. Downloads of major VPN apps rose 49% from a recent daily average of 139,000 to 208,000

key_facts.fact: Proton VPN downloads on Apple's App Store rose 113%, Turbo VPN rose 85%, NordVPN App Store downloads rose 41%, ExpressVPN on Google Play rose 31%.
key_facts.excerpt: Downloads of Proton VPN on Apple's App Store in India jumped 113%, while Turbo VPN downloads rose 85%. On Google Play, downloads of Proton VPN climbed 64% and Turbo VPN downloads increased 35%. NordVPN's App Store downloads increased 41%, while ExpressVPN downloads on Google Play rose 31%.

key_facts.fact: Proton said daily registrations from India rose 120% above baseline on Wednesday, after hourly registrations spiked 150% on Tuesday evening following the restriction.
key_facts.excerpt: Proton said daily registrations from India rose 120% above baseline levels on Wednesday, after hourly registrations had already spiked 150% on Tuesday evening following the Telegram restriction.

key_facts.fact: India's Ministry of Electronics and IT issued the order under Section 69A of the IT Act, delisting Telegram from Indian storefronts until June 22 and separately directing Telegram to disable its message-editing feature in India until June 30.
key_facts.excerpt: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology's order under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act carried two directives. The first, delisting Telegram from Google and Apple's Indian storefronts until 22 June, was a blunt instrument. The second was more surgical: Telegram was separately directed to disable its message-editing feature in India until 30 June.

key_facts.fact: Telegram challenged the order in the Delhi High Court, arguing authorities should target specific content rather than block the entire platform; the court upheld the restriction on Friday.
key_facts.excerpt: Telegram challenged the order in the Delhi High Court, arguing that authorities should target specific content rather than block the entire platform. The court, however, upheld the restriction on Friday.

key_facts.fact: The restriction was tied to the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG) re-test, with the National Testing Agency flagging Telegram channels like 'PAPER LEAKED NEET' and 'Re-Neet 2026' allegedly soliciting payment for purported exam material.
key_facts.excerpt: The NTA flagged several channels operating under names including 'PAPER LEAKED NEET', 'Re-Neet 2026' and 'Private Mafia', allegedly soliciting payments from a few thousand to several lakh rupees for purported exam material.

key_facts.fact: The X account of Proton VPN GM David Peterson was withheld in India after he posted about the surge in signups.
key_facts.excerpt: Proton VPN's General Manager David Peterson's X account has been withheld in India after he tweeted that the service saw a massive increase in sign-ups.

stories.headline: Apple opens iOS to alternative app marketplaces and external payments in Brazil under CADE deal

key_facts.fact: Apple announced on June 18 that iOS developers in Brazil can distribute apps through alternative marketplaces and process payments outside Apple's In-App Purchase, as part of a settlement with Brazilian competition regulator CADE.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple today announced changes impacting iOS apps in Brazil that reflect a recent agreement with Brazil's competition regulator, the Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (CADE). These updates create new options for developers to distribute apps on alternative app marketplaces and to process app payments for digital goods and services outside of Apple In-App Purchase.

key_facts.fact: Apps distributed outside the App Store will pay a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital goods and services; alternative marketplaces must be authorized by Apple.
key_facts.excerpt: Core Technology Commission: iOS apps distributed outside of the App Store in Brazil will pay a 5 percent commission on the sale of digital goods and services, including paid apps.

key_facts.fact: Inside the App Store, the standard commission on digital goods drops to a maximum of 21% (from up to 30%), with a reduced 10% rate for Small Business Program, Video Partner Program, and subscriptions after their first year; in-app purchase adds a 5% processing fee.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the new terms, developers who distribute their apps through the App Store and use Apple's IAP system will be subject to a 5% payment processing fee, plus a 21% App Store commission. That commission drops to 10% for developers enrolled in programs such as the App Store Small Business Program, Video Partner Program, and Mini Apps Partner Program

key_facts.fact: Developers who direct users to an external website will pay a 15% Store Services Commission for purchases completed within seven days of an external purchase link tap.
key_facts.excerpt: Developers who distribute their apps through the App Store and direct users to an external payment provider will pay a 15% Store Services Commission.

key_facts.fact: The changes ship on iOS 26.5 and later; current Apple Developer Program members must agree to the updated license terms by July 6, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: These changes are available on iOS 26.5 and later, and they are the result of regulatory action from Brazil's competition regulator.

key_facts.fact: The CADE dispute originated from a 2022 complaint by Latin American e-commerce giant MercadoLibre.
key_facts.excerpt: Late last year, Apple reached an agreement with Brazil's competition watchdog, CADE, resolving a dispute that began in 2022 after Latin American e-commerce giant MercadoLibre filed a complaint over the company's App Store rules.
